messages.content:
我是做小家电的外贸业务员，帮我回复这条阿里巴巴国际站的询盘，用买家的语言，尽量拿下订单：

Hello, do you have FCC and ETL for the 4.5L air fryer? We want 800 units, PTFE-free basket preferred. Target price USD 20 FOB. Can you ship within 30 days?

content:
{"reply": "Hi [Buyer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry about our 4.5L air fryer. Here are answers to each of your questions.

1. Certifications (FCC & ETL)
Our 4.5L model holds [FCC certificate/report No. ___] and [ETL listing No. ___], issued by [testing lab]. I can send you copies of both today so your team can verify them before you order. Since these certifications are for the North American market, the unit runs on 120V/60Hz with a US plug.

2. PTFE-free basket
We offer two PTFE-free options for this model:
- Ceramic-coated basket: non-stick, easy to clean, and the most popular choice with US retailers
- Stainless steel basket: very durable and fully coating-free
Both are food-contact safe, and we can provide [FDA / LFGB] test reports.

3. Price for 800 units, FOB [Port]
- Standard version: USD [__]/unit
- Ceramic-coated PTFE-free basket: USD [__]/unit
- Stainless steel basket: USD [__]/unit
I understand your target is USD 20. If we [adjust the color box packaging / simplify the accessories / use our standard housing color], we can bring the PTFE-free version to USD [__], close to your target. I'm happy to work through these options with you.

4. Delivery
We can ship within [__] days after we receive your deposit and you confirm the artwork. Keeping a standard color and simple logo printing makes a 30-day schedule easier to meet. If your timeline is tight, I can reserve production capacity for your order now.

To send you an exact quotation, could you please confirm:
- Which basket type you prefer (ceramic or stainless steel)
- Housing color, and whether you need your logo on the unit or packaging
- Packaging requirements (color box, retail-ready, Amazon FBA labeling, etc.)
- Your preferred payment terms

We can also send a pre-production sample so you can check quality before placing the order. If it helps, I'm available for a quick video call to show you the product and our factory.

I look forward to working with you on this order.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Company Name]
WhatsApp/WeChat: [__]
Email: [__]"}
